engine.transform_convention: Row-major 4x4 matrices multiply homogeneous column vectors; translations are millimetres.
engine.coordinate_limitation: The matrix exactly records commanded frame translations. Float32 export and 0.001 mm engine vertex quantization alter geometry separately.
engine.raw_file_disposition: Commands disabled, compressed, temporary raw file removed.

deposition.coordinate_frame: Exact supplied print STL coordinates in millimetres
limitations: Filament E is commanded material; actual extrusion, density and shrinkage need a scale and coupons.
The primary inertia integrates uniform deposited line segments at the middle of each layer.
The optional rectangular section correction estimates sensitivity to finite bead width; it does not reconstruct pressure, corner overlap or real cross-sections.
Retraction recovery is excluded. A moving recovery deposits fresh material only along the remaining tail under a simple no-pressure-storage model.
Per-category path times omit acceleration, travel, cooling and other delays. Only Cura total time estimates the complete slice.
Support and adhesion mass are excluded from robot-part mass, COM and inertia.
These deposition properties do not establish strength or replace the full-solid comparison scenario.

estimate_basis: CuraEngine 5.13.0 using acceleration limits from the installed Neptune 4 Pro definition, unchanged moderate requested accelerations, 225 mm conservative bed envelope. Actual printer configuration was not read.
limits: 11 mm3/s flow is a candidate, not a physically validated hotend limit.
0.30 mm layers are new for this part set; the familiar profile retains 0.28 mm.
Assembly and insert retention require physical confirmation.
